messages.title: Messages
messages.note: The conversations of this clinic. The lists show ids, a closed topic, who sent each message and when, and never the text. A message is read one at a time, after a confirmation, and every reading is recorded.
messages.patientInvalid: That is not a patient id. The list is not filtered by it.
messages.noMessages: There are no messages in this conversation.
messages.readBody: The text is shown here only while you keep it open. This reading is recorded under your name.
messages.readRefused: You may not read this message. Nothing was shown.
messages.readGone: This message was not found, or its text was erased. Nothing was shown.
messages.screenTitle: Screen this message for red flags?
messages.screenBody: The red-flag rules read this stored message and the result is recorded. A red flag, or a message the rules cannot assess, raises a nurse task. Nothing is sent to the patient from here.
messages.screenRefused: You may not screen this message. Nothing was recorded.
messages.screenErased: The text of this message was erased, so it cannot be screened. Nothing was recorded.
messages.screenUnavailable: Screening is not available now (encryption is not set up). Nothing was recorded.

outcome.clear: The rules found no red flag.
outcome.red_flag: The rules found a red flag. A nurse task was raised.
outcome.unassessable: The rules could not assess this message. A nurse task was raised.

reply.not_required: No reply to the patient is needed.
reply.pending_clinician_template: No reply is sent: the patient-facing wording has not been written by a clinician yet.

labels.confirmBody: Shows the name, year of birth and last four digits of the phone for {{n}} patients on this list. The reading is recorded as one audit entry that holds only the count.
labels.firstOnly: Only the first {{max}} on the list are shown at a time.
labels.shown: Names shown for {{n}} patients. They go when you leave this screen.
labels.refused: You may not see names here. Nothing was shown.
labels.gone: This clinic was not found. Nothing was shown.
labels.unavailable: Names cannot be shown in this environment. Nothing was shown.
labels.tooMany: Too many patients at once. Nothing was shown.
